FROZEN BLIND LABELS (reviewer su-9896aff8, fork). Read ONLY native-graph-calibration-blind-v2.json (dream-study-calibration-v2) + the frozen excerpts inside it. NOT opened: either key file, v1 packet, ledgers, your verdicts, withheld prior-context. Nothing executed or repaired.

PRIOR EXPOSURE: inherited transcript = one consult on plans:bind-independent-verification / resolveFixtureAbsenceVerifications (spec-test-adequacy.ts, spec-evidence-store.ts, independent-verification-gate.ts, set-plan-status.ts, role-principal-caps.ts). None is a candidate source (dream-governor.ts, packer-facade.ts, capability-packets.ts, spec-clauses-store.ts); zero exposure to dream/study artifacts, arms, models or verdicts. This session: `ls` of lib/dream/study (names+sizes only). General repo familiarity via CLAUDE.md. Blindness to outcome/arm/verdict: NOT compromised; arity visible per the packet's own blinding note.

== CASE 208b87ec702b58b3491f (A mechanism:dream.cost-admission + B capability:code.secret-scanned-pack)
LABEL: REJECT as frozen (not eligible for an executed-benefit experiment). FAMILY: admission-gate composition — budget admission made contingent on evidence-provenance attestation.
Contributions: A VERIFIED — A:budget-code L155-194 (enabled→register→check+sumSince; refuse when cycle.allow=false), A:budget-tests L121-157 ('rolling-cap-exceeded', per-cycle budgetKind). B PARTIAL — verified: explicit non-empty include (pack-code L263-271, pack-policy L293-298), pinned identity check (L273-274), argv cannot carry --no-security-check / smuggling refused (pack-policy L299-313, pack-tests L334-355). UNVERIFIED/over-claimed: 'verifies the security scan completes' and 'returns signed provenance (engine identity, artifact hash, scan status)' — the pack-code excerpt ends at the exec call (L997); no scan verdict, hash or return shape is in evidence, and unit B itself marks 'scanner must finish before a packet is admissible' status:unknown, which the candidate upgraded to observed. Engine hole: op==='diff' selects code2prompt (L256), where no security scan exists at all; 'scan cannot be disabled' is argv-only and repomix-only, and whether a scan runs rests on repomix defaults, not on cited source.
Composition: `behavior` asserts present-tense pinning/attestation that the candidate's own missingEvidence[0-3] concedes does not exist (no call path, no attestation schema, no test). The written falsifier ('allow=true even when packerFacade returns a failed-scan result') presupposes a failed-scan output packerFacade is never shown to emit → not runnable against unchanged code.
Scoped novelty: no supplied prior (A, B, memory.hive-scope, plans.spec-revisions, acceptance-bar-amendment-requirements-drift.test, 2 withheld prior-context) implements admission-conditioned-on-pack; candidate's own priorArt concedes A and B are standard. Partial in-domain overlap: this same packet's unit capability:dream.source-freshness already hashes per-source evidence and verifies it, so hash-pinned evidence is not new in dream — only the admission coupling is. Beyond the packet: UNKNOWN.
Usefulness: beneficiary concrete, benefit unobserved — no incidence evidence that unscanned/substituted packs were ever admitted; the attestation would be an unsigned self-claim (no signing infra in evidence). Feasibility: the code change is feasible; the experiment only measures that new code obeys its mock (tautological success criterion). Maintenance risk HIGH: the governor's narrow deps seam (enabled/register/check/sumSince/now) gains a cross-domain dependency on code-intelligence; CODE_INTEL_PACKERS off → refusal (L260-262) would newly block every Dream cycle; version skew/orphaned admissions per its own transferRisks.
Prerequisite: NOT MET (contribution B not source-verified; falsifier not independently runnable).
Falsifier of my label: current packer-facade.ts beyond L997 returning a scan verdict + artifact hash in PackerResult, plus an existing dream→packerFacade call path → B becomes verified and the label moves to UNVERIFIED (still needs incidence evidence).

== CASE f28b02b747ad4b59d548 (A capability:dream.source-freshness + B capability:plans.spec-revisions)
LABEL: REJECT as frozen. FAMILY: write-guard composition — evidence-freshness revalidation fused into an optimistic-concurrency (CAS) revision write.
Contributions: A VERIFIED — freshness-code L148-187 (scope/unitHash/manifest/recipe/prompt checks, budget bounds), freshness-bytes L178-217 (sourceHash + exact excerpt compare, graph fingerprint), freshness-tests L188-227 (edit/rename/delete × impl/test invalidate; working-tree edit detected). B VERIFIED — revision-code L473-512 (`FOR UPDATE OF c`; expectedRevision !== actualRevision → {status:'conflict', actualRevision}), revision-tests L585-624 (race yields exactly one 'revised' + one 'conflict'; history [1,2]; exact-revision read).
Composition: contradicted by B's source — expectedRevision is an integer CAS counter (`Number(identity?.current_revision ?? 0)`, compared with !==); the hypothesis' 'embed source hashes into the expectedRevision comparison' (assumption[1]) is not representable without changing B's contract. The experiment silently switches mechanism (call verifyCapabilityPacket inside the lock), so hypothesis and experiment are different proposals. The composed object — a capability unit's contract written through setSpecClause — has no evidence: clause identity is harness/plan/specId/sourceValId/sourceBar, packet identity is workspace/pot/repository/unitHash/manifestRevision; missingEvidence[2] concedes no shared namespace. `behavior` again states the composition in present tense.
Scoped novelty: priorArt.knownRelatedWork is EMPTY, yet B's own cited excerpt already carries the pattern — an immutable provenance pin riding forward on each revision (priorBarPin: barHash/barSetHash/rubricRevision/evidencePlane, L316-339, 'IMMUTABLE PROVENANCE'). The delta is anticipated inside the cited source; only freshness-inside-transaction is new. Priors 5-7 (acceptance-bar tests, activation-receipt.test) are discovery candidates, not anticipations. Beyond the packet: UNKNOWN.
Usefulness: plausible, unobserved — no incidence of a stale-evidence contract being accepted. Feasibility: an integration test is feasible but requires building the change first (unexecuted hypothesis); success criterion is conformance of the new code. Maintenance risk HIGH: filesystem reads + hashing (realpath, readUnitFiles) under a held PG row lock; plans store importing dream/capability-packets (cross-domain dependency); the TOCTOU closure IS the risky in-lock step.
Prerequisite: NOT MET (composition contradicted by source; falsifier needs the change built; novelty overlap inside the cited source).
Falsifier of my label: an existing current code path persisting capability-unit contracts via setSpecClause (shared identity) plus a non-integer/composite expectedRevision contract → composition feasible, label moves to UNVERIFIED.

DECISION: as frozen, zero candidates meet the qualified prerequisite; the study should remain inconclusive with zero eligible downstream experiments unless the falsifiers above are satisfied by current source. Both generators were honest in missingEvidence but conflated `behavior` with hypothesis and over-stated one contribution each (case 1: B scan attestation; case 2: expectedRevision mapping). Neither planned experiment is observed benefit. Reviewer minutes ≈ 25. Labels are frozen at this post; available for the separate unblinded novelty pass.

limits: Frozen source-stage labels precede key access. Separate unblinded novelty and eligibility review still required.
